dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged high-contrast perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from dark dorsal pixels to high-intensity white; featuring one large central closed-loop 'O' and several adjacent semi-closed 'C' structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Scattered, low-density clusters of solid high-intensity white pixels without internal gradients, primarily located anteriorly and superiorly to the main annular complex.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationship defined by an obtuse triangle formed by the centroids of the two largest dorsal annuli and a third prominent 'C' shaped structure located posteriorly.
